dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Uh... I'm... not very good at making conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Most of my time I spend alone in the laboratory, researching for many hours at a time.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: If an experiment doesn't quite go to plan, it can even end up being several days.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I don't know much about what goes on in the outside world... or the kinds of things that people like to talk about...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: And, um... I don't really like to go out and socialize much, even on my days off.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Oh... If it's with you, then...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: No, no... I still don't know what would be appropriate to talk about.

choices.text: You can just talk about whatever comes to mind.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Hearing you say this makes me feel more at ease.

choices.text: It's okay to have nothing particular to talk about, you know...
